path_base: Repository root for local_path, path and port.file; manifest_entry fields are preserved verbatim, including original acquisition cache paths.

selection.formula: observed stars * accepted NumPy call sites, including ndarray methods
selection.unit: whole gist at pinned revision, not an individual file
caveats: Stars are the saved observations, not refreshed current stars.
Call sites are statically attributed occurrences across the measured gist, not runtime executions or calls in the C# port.
Ranking describes the measured corpus, not every public gist.

scope.approved: Functional numerical routines only; full framework applications and their dependencies are out of scope.
scope.execution_policy: Reviewed numerical definitions and independently written NumPy/SciPy references may be evaluated for parity. Original scripts are not executed as complete framework/audio/plotting applications.
scope.copyright_note: No bulk original source or prose is reproduced here. Attribution is not a license grant; observed declarations and gaps are recorded per gist.

verification.method: Read saved ranking and origin files.jsonl; require matching entity revision; SHA256-hash every cached Python source and compare byte count/hash with its manifest; independently UTF-8 encode pinned API file content and require the same hash/size; hash each pinned API JSON and the ranking/provenance inputs.
verification.claim_boundary: Upstream evidence integrity and attribution only. Numerical parity coverage and measured results are documented in README.md and test artifacts.
